body:
Implement ADLC v1.13.0 Wave 1A Part 1 Foundational Security & Containment across @adlc/core, @adlc/gate-fuzzing, @adlc/review-calibration, @adlc/fleet, and Codex/Copilot/Cursor generated bundles:

1. @adlc/core (T-P01, T-P03): Add --no-renames to changedFiles; harden shell classifiers (shellHasOpaqueMutation, shellHasWriteOption, shellIsPositivelyReadOnly excluding node --test, singleLiteralInterpreterWriteTarget, git --ext-diff/--textconv rejection); enforce leaf-only ignorePaths matching unless explicitly directory-scoped; promote shared sandbox-runner.mjs with root-owned canonical launcher pinning (resolveSandboxBinary) and CODE_INJECTION_ENV_RE environment sanitization; regenerate Codex/Copilot generated-shell.mjs and Cursor MCP wrapper bundle.
2. @adlc/gate-fuzzing & @adlc/review-calibration (T-P03): Delegate sandbox detection/spawning to @adlc/core sandbox-runner; enforce fail-closed read-only-checkout witness sandboxing (--unsafe-no-sandbox escape hatch) and ADLC_SANDBOX_REVIEW_CMD=1 containment; enforce symlink-chain target containment across automatic commit selection, witness/syntax verification, and plant execution.
3. @adlc/fleet (T-P02, T-P09): Add iterative depth/count/byte-bounded assertGitDirTreeSafe bare-mirror containment; enforce root-owned launcher pinning, PID/IPC/UTS namespace unsharing on both BOUNDED and HOST profiles, realpath-validated BOUNDED read-only mounts, and per-dispatch private temporary directories in model-plane/SafeSandbox/live-deps; verify clean working tree before worker self-commit fallback; narrow agy/jetski homeState writable subpaths and enforce canonical ancestor-verified binary resolution in gemini adapter.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Core git --no-renames, leaf-only ignorePaths, shell classifiers, and regenerated hook/MCP bundles pass all tests. Verify: npm --workspace=@adlc/core test && node scripts/copilot-install-smoke.mjs . && node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/mcp-wrapper.test.mjs
2. Promoted sandbox-runner, gate-fuzzing, and review-calibration containment tests pass. Verify: npm --workspace=@adlc/gate-fuzzing --workspace=@adlc/review-calibration test
3. Fleet mirror containment, BOUNDED/HOST sandbox mounts, per-dispatch private temp dir, worker self-commit guard, and adapter subpath tests pass. Verify: npm --workspace=@adlc/fleet test
title: Wave 1A Part 1: Core shell/revision hardening, sandbox-runner promotion, and fleet/calibration containment
